theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s t hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    constructor <;> intro s' ht <;> cases ht with
    | choiceL ht =>
      unfold lts at *
      grind only [→ Bisimilarity.follow_fst, → Bisimilarity.follow_snd,
        Tr.choiceL, ChoiceBisim.bisim]
    | choiceR ht =>
      exact ⟨_, .choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    grind only [→ Bisimilarity.follow_fst, → Bisimilarity.follow_snd, ChoiceBisim.bisim]

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s t hr μ
  cases hr <;> rename_i h
  all_goals constructor <;> intro s' ht
  case' choice.left | choice.right =>
    cases ht <;> rename_i ht
  case choice.left.choiceR | choice.right.choiceR =>
    exact ⟨_, .choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  all_goals
    first
    | apply (h.follow_fst ?_).elim
      rotate_right
      assumption
    | apply (h.follow_snd ?_).elim
      rotate_right
      assumption
    rintro t' ⟨ht', h'⟩
    refine ⟨t', ?_, .bisim h'⟩
    first | exact .choiceL ht' | exact ht'

    rintro t' ⟨ht', h'⟩
    refine ⟨t', ?_, .bisim h'⟩
    first | assumption | exact .choiceL ht'

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists ChoiceBisim, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  rintro s t (h | h) μ
  all_goals constructor <;> intro s' ht
  case' choice.left | choice.right =>
    cases ht <;> rename_i ht
  case choice.left.choiceR | choice.right.choiceR =>
    exact ⟨_, .choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  all_goals
    first | have := h.follow_fst ht | have := h.follow_snd ht
    rcases this with ⟨t', ht', h'⟩
    grind only [ChoiceBisim.bisim, Tr.choiceL, lts]

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists ChoiceBisim, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  rintro s t (h | h) μ
  all_goals constructor <;> intro s' ht
  case' choice.left | choice.right =>
    cases ht <;> rename_i ht
  case choice.left.choiceR | choice.right.choiceR =>
    exact ⟨_, .choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  all_goals
    first | apply (h.follow_fst ht).elim | apply (h.follow_snd ht).elim
    rintro t' ⟨ht', h'⟩
    refine ⟨t', ?_, .bisim h'⟩
    solve_by_elim [Tr.choiceL]

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  exists _, ChoiceBisim.choice h

  · constructor

  rintro s t (h | h) μ s' ht
  case' choice =>

  case choice.choiceR =>

  all_goals
    obtain ⟨t', ht', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
    refine ⟨t', ?_, .bisim h'⟩
    try apply Tr.choiceL
    exact ht'
